title: Knox
description: Knox is a lightweight, informational GUI mod to view important info at a glance without having to toggle F3.
body:
# Knox
**Quick information at a glance, without having to press F3**

A customizable GUI menu on your screen which shows you information like your local time, FPS, CPS, Direction, RAM usage, etc. at a glance, anywhere on your screen.

Customizable size, colors, and items to be shown are available by pressing "K" in-game once loaded.

Currently only supports Fabric, will change in the future.
